description: This file defines the ErrorHandlerInterface within the Slim Framework, specifying the method signature for handling errors in HTTP request/response cycles.

classes.name: ErrorHandlerInterface
classes.description: Interface declaring a method for handling errors, requiring an implementation that takes request, exception, and log/display flags, and returns a Response.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an error by producing a response based on the request, exception, and display/log flags.
